root_cause.text: An off-by-one error in the loop condition `i <= dev->online_queues` within the `nvme_dbbuf_set` function allowed the index to exceed the valid range of the `dev->queues` array, causing a slab-out-of-bounds read.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff changes the loop condition from `i <= dev->online_queues` to `i < dev->online_queues`, and the CVE description explicitly states that valid indices are 0 through `dev->online_queues − 1`, confirming that the original condition permitted access to an invalid index.

agent_logs.root_cause_candidate: An off-by-one error in the `nvme_dbbuf_set` function loop condition allowed an out-of-bounds array access on `dev->queues` when iterating up to `dev->online_queues` inclusive instead of exclusive.

vuln_statements.explanation: The loop condition uses '<=' instead of '<', allowing i to reach dev->online_queues + 1, which exceeds the valid bounds of dev->queues array. This off-by-one error causes slab-out-of-bounds read when accessing dev->queues[i] with an invalid index.
